network.why: Your connection or the server is down.

timeout.what: Heimdall took too long to answer.
timeout.why: The server is busy or your connection is slow.

signedOut.why: You were signed out after a while away. Sign in again; what you typed is kept.

forbidden.why: Ask an admin of your organization.

notFound.why: It was deleted, or the link is old. It may belong to another organization.

conflict.what: This changed while you were editing.
conflict.why: Someone else saved first. Reload to see the latest; your text is kept.

invalid.why: Check the marked fields and try again.

tooLarge.what: This is too large to send.
tooLarge.why: Send a smaller file or fewer rows.

planLimit.what: Your plan does not cover this.
planLimit.why: Upgrade the plan in Settings, Billing.

rateLimited.why: The server limits requests per minute. Wait a moment and try again.

server.why: A server error; it was logged. Try again; if it keeps failing, copy the details for support.

workerRefused.why: See the details for the reason, then open the run log.

noModelKey.what: No model key for this provider.
noModelKey.why: Runs call the model with your organization's key. Add one in Settings, API keys.

budgetReached.why: Raise the budget and rerun the rest.

imagePreparing.why: The first run of this benchmark builds it. It starts by itself.

unknown.why: Try again; if it keeps failing, copy the details for support.

errors.otherOrg: It may belong to another organization. Switch organization in the menu at the top.

refused.why: This server does not allow the change; the details say why.

loading.tooSlowWhy: The server may be busy. Try again.

hint.notMeasured: Nothing was measured here, so there is no number.
hint.noModelCall: No model call, so no tokens and no cost.

leave.title: Leave this page?
leave.body: What you typed is kept as a draft.

experiments.selectPage: Select every comparison on this page
experiments.confirmBody: This deletes the selected comparisons and their runs. It cannot be undone.
experiments.deleteError: Could not delete every selected comparison.

login.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to go back to {{page}}.
